title: docs(idd-merge): require unclaimed-by marker post in F4 cleanup
body:
## Background

`.github/instructions/idd-merge.instructions.md`'s F4 (Cleanup) section
(around line 276 onward) never mentions posting an `unclaimed-by`
marker as part of cleanup. An adopter who added their own explicit,
standalone instruction line requiring this marker post observed the
gap close immediately and stay closed across several subsequent runs,
suggesting the omission itself (not an unrelated cleanup-ordering
issue) was the cause of the marker being silently skipped.

## Proposed change

Add an explicit, standalone instruction line to the F4 (Cleanup)
section of `idd-merge.instructions.md` requiring the `unclaimed-by`
marker to be posted as part of cleanup, mirroring how other required
F4 marker posts are already stated as their own explicit steps rather
than being implied by surrounding prose.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `idd-merge.instructions.md`'s F4 section contains an explicit,
      standalone instruction line requiring the `unclaimed-by` marker
      post
- [ ] the added line follows the same phrasing/formatting convention
      as neighboring explicit F4 marker-post instructions
- [ ] `node scripts/audit-docs.mjs --check` passes

---

_Autopilot suitability: 5 / 5 -- higher is more autopilot-suitable;
below the configured floor is human-oriented._
